summary: Verified new 'Moderator Aktif' + 'Reaksi Hidup' additions to Video Room. Backend pytest 5/5 passed in 59s (/app/backend/tests/test_video_meeting.py, junit at /app/test_reports/pytest/video_meeting.xml): (1) summary 400 on empty meeting; (2) summary 400 on private conversation (new guard); (3) summary endpoint creates exactly one meeting_notes task (goal starts 'Notulen', status completed, non-empty summary); (4) NEW moderator interject logic — on a fresh meeting, turn 1 (odd) emits NO is_moderator events, turn 2 (even) emits is_moderator start+final with moderator_kind='interject', content short (<=400 chars), tasks count unchanged across both turns (confirmed via GET /api/tasks diff before/after); (5) legacy moderator=true path still emits full moderator final block (moderator_kind!='interject') and creates one new meeting_notes task. Frontend (desktop 1440x900, demo@aivora.ai, group cid 04d5c2c9...): video-call-btn visible in header, click opens video-room overlay; tiles rendered — vr-tile-me, vr-tile-Rio, vr-tile-Nova, vr-tile-mod; all 5 controls present (vr-mute, vr-send, vr-captions, vr-end-save, vr-leave) with no overlap; vr-leave closes overlay cleanly. 'Asisten' fallback label logic confirmed in code (VideoRoom.jsx line 52) — not visually triggered in this group because both personas are named; vr-reaction element exists in Tile (line 58) and fireReaction is wired into drainQueue (line 200), gated by mic-driven runTurn which cannot execute headless (per request guidance, not failed).
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py interject branch (lines 230-251) correctly uses count_documents on {role:'user'} AFTER the user message has been inserted, so turn parity is based on the completed turn count — matches spec ('fires on turn 2,4,...'). Deterministic and no task insert. Good.
chat.py meeting_summary now guards conv.type=='private' with 400 — matches new regression requirement.
VideoRoom.jsx Tile data-testid still uses persona.name as suffix; if two personas share a name in a meeting the testid will collide. Low priority (carried over from iter_3).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (video-call-btn, overlay, me+mod+2 persona tiles, 5 controls, leave)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted 3 TEST_ meetings (TEST_empty, TEST_interject, TEST_modtrue) and 1 TEST_priv private conv during tests; added 1 meeting_notes task via legacy moderator=true path and 1 via /summary on legacy meeting cid dba6c41f...
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_video_meeting.py; export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest. Interject branch depends on even user-message count; always create a fresh meeting if you need to control parity. Headless browser cannot test the mic-driven runTurn loop, so vr-reaction and per-turn TTS are not UI-testable — only verify Tile markup contains the reaction span and VideoRoom controls render.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Previous iter_3 test_send_moderator_false_skips_moderator_block would have failed under new logic because the legacy meeting had an odd/even state outside test control; replaced with a fresh-meeting deterministic test that checks both turn 1 (no mod) and turn 2 (interject + no task).
